Nora: Quick sync 1: drafting the internal RN for service v2.5.0. We need an embargo note for partners and a short ops pin. Can we lock a window?
Ben: Drop bullets, I can trim and post the internal blast.
Nora: Draft bullets: 
```
- Feature: adaptive batching threshold tuning for chat flows (reduced tails)
- Fix: rare KV cache double-free in long-lived sessions
- Ops: EU embeddings pinned to rwd-embed-4 for this release; fallback to rwd-embed-3
- Infra: new canary policy that pauses on health regressions (auto-fallback to v2.4.x)
- Note: partner embargo until 24h after full rollout
```
Sasha: I'm oncall during the window. Prefer smoke 09:15 PT and deploy 09:45 PT so we have a 30m observation window before EOD.
Kai: I'll own rollback. My triggers: sustained error increase >1% for 5m, p99 >900ms for 3m, or customer-seen 5xxs >2% in 5m.
Nora: Perfect. Who will take ops pin and post the pinned RN after smoke passes?
Ben: I'll claim ops pin and post the pin + escalation matrix once Sasha confirms smoke green.
Nora: Plan: canary 10% 10m -> ramp 50% 10m -> full. Auto-fallback to v2.4.x. Embargo note: do not share externally until I send the partner safe copy.
ReleaseBot: /schedule deploy service:v2.5.0 env:prod start:2026-04-10T09:45:00-07:00 rollout:canary(10%:10m)->ramp(50%:10m)->full fallback:service:v2.4.x
